description: I am Ritesh Kumar Singh, a BCA student who is passionate about space technology, data science and AI. I have skills in Python, Machine Learning/AI and data analysis and I love to take NASA’s open Earth and space data and turn it into practical real-world solutions. Looking for motivated team mates with web/app dev, UI/UX, research or presentation skills. Join me to learn, innovate and build a strong NASA Space Apps Challenge solution together!
